subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay bounded media from unmentioned group messages into later mentioned turns, and what media kinds, TTL, local-path exposure, and visibility limits should apply?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the repair changes how bystander group attachments can enter later model context, which is a privacy/security boundary automation should not choose.

options.title: Approve bounded image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and replay it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization rules.

options.title: Keep text-only history
options.body: Preserve the safer current behavior and document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed unless it is part of the current or replied-to turn.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep this open until a proposed PR demonstrates the exact Telegram failure and bounded retention behavior with redacted live proof.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and replay it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The Telegram message-context split and current owner boundary history make this the best available routing candidate for the security/product choice.
